title: Old Fashioned Russian Lamb Pie
description: A traditional Russian dish featuring lamb leg in a flaky crust, this pie is a nostalgic and savory treat. It is made with a low glycemic index in mind, using almond flour and minimal sugar.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the lamb cubes over medium high heat until browned on all sides.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked lamb mixture, almond flour, and egg, mixing until just combined.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Roll out the almond flour mixture on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spoon the lamb mixture into the center of the dough circle, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Place the pie on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 40 minutes.
